title: Jude and the Letter
author: Dominic Montrose
blurb: Beatrix Thornbury, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
